entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand sensor you sold me is a complete piece of garbage! The pulse reading is all over the place. I want to return it.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing issues with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault you're seeing with the sensor itself?
What did I just say? Yes, it's a fault! It doesn't work! Look, I don't have time for a bunch of questions. I just want my money back.

I understand your frustration, and I want to get this sorted out for you. We can definitely look into a refund. I just need to ask if you'd be willing to try a quick reset? If that doesn't work, I can get you over to our technical team.

Are you kidding me? I told you, I don't have time for this nonsense! I'm not your IT guy. Just process the refund. It's a defective product. This is ridiculous. I want my money back or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet.
Okay, I understand. No need for a transfer. Let me pull up your account and I'll check the return eligibility for you right now. Can I get your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. You received it on December 15th, so about 21 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this for you.
So you're finally giving me the refund?

Yes, I am. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now, and I'll email it over. As soon as our warehouse receives the VeloBand, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. The email should be in your inbox in the next five minutes.
Fine. About time. Make sure you send that label.
It's on its way. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I apologize again for the trouble you've had.
